about.title: About Tecnolpet
about.lead: Committed to quality products and services for oil and gas.

about.mission: We provide high-quality tools, equipment, and services that exceed expectations, with strong commitment to people safety and environmental care.

about.quality: Customer growth and total satisfaction through inspection and testing that meet or exceed expectations, with continual improvement of the management system.
about.social: Be a reference in principles and values; cooperate with the community on good social practices.

privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.lead: How Tecnolpet S.A. handles personal and business information.
privacy.intro: This policy describes the information we process to support applications and services provided by Tecnolpet S.A. The types of information we collect depend on how you use our products and services.
privacy.contactNote: To exercise access, correction, or deletion rights, email mail@tecnolpet.com.

sections.title: I. What information do we collect?
paragraphs: Information and content you provide: we collect content, communications, and other information you submit when using our services, including registration or contact, inquiry, careers, and report forms. This may include related metadata.
Business networks and relationships: we collect information about clients, services, collaborators, and service results needed to deliver NDT inspection, testing, and operational support.
Product use: we collect information about how you use our products (actions, features used, frequency, and duration) to operate, secure, and improve the service.
Transactions: if you make payments to our organization, we may collect purchase or transaction information, billing data, and contact details needed to complete the process.

Device information: we may collect technical data from your browser or device (operating system, browser type, IP address, time zone, language, and cookie data) for security, performance, and user experience.

sections.title: II. How do we use this information?
paragraphs: To provide, personalize, and improve our inspection products and services.
To validate client and collaborator access and communicate operational information when appropriate.
Research and development: to develop, test, and improve our services.
Safety and integrity: to verify accounts and activity, and to prevent abuse, spam, and misuse of the platform.
Communication: to send product and policy information and to respond when you contact us.

sections.title: III. How is this information shared?
paragraphs: Client information is treated confidentially. It is not shared with third parties or used for purposes other than those intended, except with authorization or legal obligation.
When sharing is required, Tecnolpet will request signed authorization stating purpose and scope, unless required by law or a competent authority.

sections.title: IV. Legal basis for processing
paragraphs: We process data as needed to fulfill our Terms of use; with your consent (which you may revoke); and to meet legal obligations applicable in Ecuador.

sections.title: V. Your rights
paragraphs: You may request access, correction, portability, or objection to processing, and unsubscribe from marketing communications where applicable.
To exercise these rights, contact mail@tecnolpet.com or +593-62378070.

sections.title: VI. Retention and deletion
paragraphs: We store data as long as needed to provide services and products, or while legal or contractual obligations remain. Reporting systems may retain data longer based on technical and regulatory requirements.
When you delete an account or request deletion, we remove related items to the extent legally possible. The requester assumes responsibility for that request.

sections.title: VII. Legal requests and harm prevention
paragraphs: We may access, retain, and share information with authorities when we believe in good faith that the law requires it, or to detect, prevent, and address fraud, unauthorized use, terms violations, or other harmful or illegal activity.

terms.title: Terms of use
terms.lead: Conditions governing use of tecnolpet.com and Tecnolpet S.A. applications.
terms.intro: These Terms of use govern Tecnolpet S.A. and describe the Tecnolpet Service. By creating an account in Tecnolpet applications or using the site and its applications, you agree to these terms.

sections.title: The Service
paragraphs: We agree to provide you the Tecnolpet Service and its applications. The Service includes products, features, applications, services, technologies, and software we offer to advance our mission: delivering quality services for oil, gas, and general industry.

sections.title: Positive, inclusive, and safe environment
paragraphs: We develop tools and resources so clients and collaborators have a positive and inclusive experience. We maintain teams and systems to combat abuse, policy violations, and harmful or deceptive behavior.

sections.title: Technology and infrastructure
paragraphs: We create and use technologies that help personalize, protect, and improve the Service. Automated technologies also help ensure functionality and integrity.
To deliver the Service we may store and transfer data across our systems, including outside your country of residence. This infrastructure may be owned by Tecnolpet S.A. or authorized third parties.

sections.title: Research and innovation
paragraphs: We use the information we have to study and improve the Service and to collaborate on improvements that benefit clients and collaborators.

sections.title: Data policy
paragraphs: Providing the Service requires collecting and using information. The Privacy policy explains how we collect, use, and share information, and how you can control it.

sections.title: Your commitments
paragraphs: Platform services are intended for users capable of conducting commercial activity.
You must be at least 18 years old.
We must not have previously disabled your account for violations of law or our policies.
Misuse of the site, unauthorized copying of proprietary materials, and any activity that compromises platform security are prohibited.

sections.title: Content and services
paragraphs: Site content is informational. Service specifications are confirmed in quotes and contracts.
Applicable law is that of the Republic of Ecuador.
